exposure: Shannon entropy of deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE) lesion
Shannon entropy of adjacent perilesional tissue
outcome: differentiation of DIE lesions from adjacent tissue
cohort: Fertile women with histologically confirmed parametrial endometriosis and high-quality ultrasound images.
finding: Shannon entropy analysis distinguishes deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE) lesions from perilesional tissue, and the entropy of DIE lesions exhibits an inverse correlation with menstrual pain.
